{{Top|leg}}
A '''hunting license''' was a document that entitled the bearer to engage in [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]]. On [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] prior to, during and perhaps after the [[Jedi Civil War]], [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] used hunting licenses as a means to ensure that only beings who fit their standards of competency were allowed to explore the vast deserts of that [[Planet/Legends|world]]. [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] acquired such a license so that he could find the ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Star Map]] on Tatooine; in exchange, he agreed to deal with a particularly bothersome tribe of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]]. The amnesiac ex-[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] kept up his end of the bargain, though it was through peaceful means, rather than the violence that the [[Unidentified Czerka Corporation protocol officer|protocol officer]] who issued it might have preferred.

[[Marlena Venn]] obtained a hunting license herself just so that she could watch her husband, [[Tanis Venn|Tanis]], attempt to get out of the trap she had laid for him by sabotaging the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] he used to help him hunt [[wraid]]s.
